_comment: The query parameters fetch(url, options) sends. Options are named as on the wire (max_chars, live, prompt); each SDK maps them to its own names. `sent` is every query parameter of the request, decoded, compared exactly: each value is the text sent. An unset option is not sent, live is sent only as "true", and an empty prompt is unset (Go cannot tell the two apart). `url` is the page asked for, "https://example.com/" when a case gives none. `skip` names an SDK whose types cannot express the case, with why.

cases.name: live true is sent as true
the prompt is sent as given

skip.go: FetchOptions.MaxChars is an int whose zero means unset, like SearchOptions.MaxResults

cases.name: the page's own query stays inside url
